record_type_quote: We conducted a replication of the eight choosing versus rejection problems in Shaﬁr (1993).

targets.title: Choosing versus rejecting: Why some options are both better and worse than others.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted a replication of the eight choosing versus rejection problems in Shaﬁr (1993).
targets.outcome_quote: We successfully replicated the results of Problem 4 and Problem 5 of the original study. However, in Problems 7 and 8 we found eﬀects in the direction opposite to the original ﬁndings and our ﬁndings for Problems 1, 2, 3, and 6 indicated support for the null hypothesis.

targets.title: Another look at reasons for choosing and rejecting.
targets.evidence_quote: We tested the competing theoretical assertion by Wedell (1997). Our results in support of this account suggest that the stimuli from the 1990s are still of relevance, at least for testing that account.

reasoning: A new sample directly retests all eight Shafir problems; authors explicitly describe two successes and other null/opposite results, yielding mixed evidence. The extension also retests Wedell’s published accentuation finding and explicitly supports it. Ganzach, Many Labs 2, Shafir (2018), and measures papers provide context rather than additional targets. There is one new experiment, so replication_study_numbers is empty.
